new_lessons.title: Canonical ZIP reproduction requires canonical package-internal metadata, not only canonical source
new_lessons.source_event: CEP_W01_W02_COLAB_CLEAN_PROVEN_PATH_v1.0 CELL 02C reproduced the intended source identity but simplified internal identity/pointer metadata, producing ZIP size 3061166 and SHA d530c9fcc459ba67d8f9b4527e9e97057bbe287b72ac0022c78ebe2010415b73 instead of canonical 3061541 / bdd7343bc2ca34e5ea0785ddce53eaaf7eff0164b93c78b7851d24b3eb6c4626.
new_lessons.root_cause: The notebook correctly distinguished source identity from container identity conceptually, but its packaging cell asserted a historical container SHA without reproducing all original package-internal bytes.
new_lessons.policy_change: When asserting an existing canonical ZIP SHA, reproduce the exact original packaging recipe: source files, package-internal metadata filenames/content/serialization, package manifest, permissions, member order, timestamps and compression recipe. If any of those intentionally change, assign a new container identity and never silently reuse the historical ZIP SHA.
